programme.title: The Pink Panther (1964)
programme.desc: In this riotously funny farce, Peter Sellers introduced the world to Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case, who is out to stop the notorious Phantom (David Niven) from stealing the priceless Pink Panther diamond!

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night (1967)
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

programme.title: Wake Of The Red Witch
programme.desc: In the 1800's, an East Indies shipping tycoon and the swash-buckling captain of a trading vessel, The Red Witch, battle for gold, priceless pearls, and the love of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang (1968)
programme.desc: A weird inventor, Caractacus Potts, invents an amazing flying car, which drives by itself. It takes him and his Family to Vulgaria, where the sinister buffoon Baron Bomburst kidnaps the car.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: When a power-crazed despot schemes to buy California from Mexico, it takes two Zorros--the legendary Don Diego de la Vega and his chosen successor Alejandro Murrieta, a dashing bandit-turned-hero-- to defeat the tyrant's unscrupulous plans.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) - and his wife, Elena (Zeta-Jones) - to take action.

programme.title: Hollow Man
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon and Elisabeth Shue play former lovers who, along with a team of other scientists like themselves, discover the secret of invisibility.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Author Kipps (Daniel Radcliffe), a widowed lawyer, is sent to a remote village to sort out the affairs of a recently deceased eccentric. But upon his arrival, it soon becomes clear that everyone in the own is keeping a deadly secret.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood’.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
programme.desc: An innocent half-Asian kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) is caught between two other races at war in prison.

programme.title: Bloodfist VI: Ground Zero
programme.desc: A kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) must prevent the launch of a nuclear missile by terrorists targeting New York.

programme.title: Bloodfist VII: Manhunt
programme.desc: Jim Trudell is a man pursued. Branded a cop-killer, he must fight simply to stay alive, and to clear his name - with the very police who framed him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Come join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burn-out who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: The Ninth Gate
programme.desc: Roman Polanski directs and Johnny Depp stars in this supernatural thriller about a rare-book dealer who discovers a demonic manuscript.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: The life of Bob Dylan is examined through multiple variations of his own personality and career, as played by a series of different actors.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game but also in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Grey Owl
programme.desc: The story of the life and work of the Canadian fur trapper-turned-conservationist who claimed to be an aboriginal North American.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Scott Eastwood stars in this action-adventure from the writers of 2 Fast 2 Furious and the director of Taken. When two legendary car thieves are caught stealing from a mafia boss, they are given a week to nab a vintage Ferrari, or risk losing everything.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell (2017)
programme.desc: Major (Scarlett Johansson) is the first of her kind, a human mind inside an artificial body. Discovering her creators lied about her past life to control her, Major will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery of her true identity and exact revenge.

programme.title: The Island

programme.title: War of the Worlds

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

programme.title: Breakdown

programme.title: North Dallas Forty

programme.title: The Russians Are Coming, The Russians Are Coming

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) - and his wife, Elena (Zeta-Jones) - to take action.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Kel are serving up laughs! They're the good guys in Good Burger, a zany comedy inspired by the popular Kel routine from Nickelodeon's hit series All That.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Bloodfist VII: Manhunt
programme.desc: Jim Trudell is a man pursued. Branded a cop-killer, he must fight simply to stay alive, and to clear his name - with the very police who framed him.

programme.title: Bloodfist VIII: Hard Way Out
programme.desc: Kickboxing champion Jake Raye thought his fighting days were over, until a call from an old friend draws him to the Far East and into the hands of a madman.

programme.title: Kickboxer 2: The Road Back
programme.desc: In this rousing sequel to Kickboxer, Tong Po broods about his defeat at the hands of Kurt Sloan. Po and his managers resort to drastic measures to goad Kurt into the ring for a rematch.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burn-out who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: When flesh-eating zombies are on the hunt, it's up to slacker Shaun and his best pal to save their friends and family from becoming the next entrée.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game but also in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four teenagers in detention discover an old video game console with a game they’ve never heard of. When they decide to play, they are immediately sucked into the jungle world of Jumanji in the bodies of their avatars.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
programme.desc: Following a failed Exorcism Megan Reed (Shay Mitchell) is working overnight at the morgue when she takes delivery of a disfigured cadaver. Soon Megan begins to experience horrifying visions and starts to suspect that the body may be possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Evil Dead (2013)
programme.desc: Five friends have found the mysterious and fiercely powerful Book of the Dead, which releases a violent demon on a bloodthirsty quest to possess them all.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: A man goes on the run after he discovers that he is actually a "harvested being", and is being kept along with others in a utopian facility.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: MAFIA
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a fierce crime boss (Ving Rhames) wreaks havoc on the streets. Detective Womack (Pam Grier) decides to put an end to this organized crime – even if it means breaking the law.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: A man searches for his missing wife after his car breaks down in the middle of the desert.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Mallrats
programme.desc: Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: Brian's Song
programme.desc: Based on the real-life relationship between teammates Brian Piccolo and Gale Sayers, the bond is established when Piccolo discovers that he is dying.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: The Return
programme.desc: The "universal soldiers" must fight the whole army, when the military's supercomputer S.E.T.H gets out of control.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover many of the fantastic characters, and thrilling situations, found in their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: In hopes of wooing a girl, Tristan promises to bring her a falling star. He soon discovers the star is actually a celestial beauty named Yvaine. When an old witch Lamia attempts to steal Yvaine's youth, Tristan must protect her.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: The Protégé
programme.desc: Rescued as a child by the legendary assassin Moody, Anna is the world's most skilled contract killer. However, when Moody is brutally killed, she vows revenge for the man who taught her everything she knows.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Beneath a woman's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the most feared assassins on the planet.

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: A hitman who's in Bangkok to pull off a series of jobs violates his personal code when he falls for a local woman and bonds with his errand boy.

programme.title: Secret Window
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Johnny Depp (2003 Best Actor, Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl) gives his most riveting performance in this action/suspense thriller featuring a top-notch cast.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon that aspires to be a swashbuckling hero finds himself in a Western town plagued by bandits and is forced to literally play the role in order to protect it.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Taking care of Arnie is mostly Gilbert's task, which can be pretty demanding, at least while you are working at the local grocery store.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: House Party

programme.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
programme.desc: After a brutal break-up, a young man vows to stay celibate during the forty days of Lent, but finds the girl of his dreams and is unable to do anything about it.

programme.title: Vacancy

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Big Jake

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps

programme.title: Quarantine 2: Terminal

programme.title: The Ring

programme.title: The Ring Two

programme.title: Major League

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Operation Condor

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm embarks on the ultimate heist – against their own company. The seemingly foolproof plan proves useless when an unexpected witness interferes, and it quickly unravels.

programme.title: Miami Blues
programme.desc: An ex-con (Alec Baldwin) tiptoes on the borderline of psychotic behavior, playing cops and robbers on both sides of the law. He robs and kills one minute and poses as a cop the next in this thriller with a comic edge.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Kel are serving up laughs! They're the good guys in Good Burger, a zany comedy inspired by the popular Kel routine from Nickelodeon's hit series All That.

programme.title: Semi-Tough
programme.desc: Barbara Jane (Jill Clayburgh), Billy Clyde (Burt Reynolds) and Shake (Kris Kristofferson) have been best friends for years. But when Barbara Jane's new interest in Shake turns into love, Billy Clyde realizes she's the woman he’s wanted all along!

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose a local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: The End
programme.desc: When Sonny (Burt Reynolds) is diagnosed with a fatal disease, he swallows a bottle of pills to end it all! Instead, he ends up in a loony bin beside the demented Marlon (Dom DeLuise) who is eager to help Sonny succeed...one madcap attempt at a time!

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
programme.desc: Bishop's most formidable foe kidnaps the love of his life in order to make him complete three impossible assassinations and make them look like accidents.

programme.title: The Protégé

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: Beneath a woman's striking beauty lies a secret that will unleash her indelible strength and skill to become one of the most feared assassins on the planet.

programme.title: Secret Window
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Johnny Depp (2003 Best Actor, Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl) gives his most riveting performance in this action/suspense thriller featuring a top-notch cast.

programme.title: Dead Man

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: House Party 2

programme.title: House Party 3
programme.desc: Prepare yourself for the ultimate house party: Kid gets engaged...and Play plans the bachelor party in House Party 3.

programme.title: The Players Club
programme.desc: A single mom tries to work her way through college, moonlighting as an exotic dancer.

programme.title: A Hip Hop Story
programme.desc: A pioneer of the culture joins forces with a few of rap music's elite performers to attempt to save hip hop.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: X (2022)
programme.desc: A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: Pearl: An X-traordinary Origin Story
programme.desc: Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical, yet gratuitous, cameos with thrillers, blockbusters, and pop-culture in general getting their best goosing yet.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programme.desc: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan

programme.title: Desperado

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan tiene una cita con Brianna y ella llega con un suéter blanco que le tejió su abuela antes de morir. Pero cuando Kel derrama soda de naranja en el suéter, los muchachos entran en pánico y se pasan toda la noche tratando de limpiarlo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Mientras están viendo un programa de investigación de delitos, Kenan y Kel se convencen de que el padre de Kenan es un ladrón conocido como el “Bandido Diamante”, e intentan devolver lo que ellos creen que son los diamantes robados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel tiene un resfriado, y Kenan decide preparar un remedio casero, usando pollo, huevos, sardinas, malvaviscos y gaseosa de naranja. Para su sorpresa, Kel se cura y ahora Kenan tiene que acordarse de la receta, cuando su papá se enferma.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan salva la vida del presidente de los Estados Unidos y es invitado a la Casa Blanca, en donde Kel, accidentalmente, destruye una fotografía muy valiosa.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan intenta invitar a una chica a una cita, que resulta ser la hija del jefe de su padre, el Sr. Dawson, pero en el proceso, Kenan y Kel dejan un mensaje escandaloso en su buzón de mensajes.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Mientras un ejército de Duel Ghouls se apodera poco a poco de la Academia Duel, ¿podrán Jaden y sus amigos encontrar la manera de batirse en duelo con estos engendros, o acabarán todos escolarizados en el proceso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: La batalla contra los Duel Ghouls se recrudece mientras Jaden intenta conseguirle a Blair la medicina que necesita. Conseguirá los primeros auxilios a tiempo o los Duel Ghouls le habrán recetado otro tipo de tratamiento?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Cuando tres pícaros estudiantes van en busca de comida, acaban mordiendo más de lo que pueden masticar. Y cuando desafían a Jaden, pronto se convierte en una batalla con el triple de acción, el triple de duelos y el triple de peligro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Con Jesse, Jim y Axel enfrentándose a tres duelistas enmascarados, no se sabe lo que puede pasar. Es una batalla sin cuartel en la que los ganadores reciben su merecido y los perdedores se quedan con hambre.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Jaden finalmente se enfrenta al estudiante formalmente conocido como Marcel. Pero antes de que Jaden pueda averiguar quién es quién, ¡empieza a desatarse un estruendo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Mientras Jaden intenta impedir que las Tres Bestias Sagradas sean liberadas, comienza una batalla por las bestias en la que Adrian Gecko decide ir él mismo a por las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Mientras Jesse se propone recuperar el legendario Dragón Arcoiris, Jaden se encuentra en duelo con un amigo desconocido que quiere vengarse.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: One Piece - Fishman Island Saga

programme.title: Death Note

programme.desc: Las sospechas de L se profundizan, Light lo persuade de invitarlo a la investigación, pero en ese momento una llamada de teléfono les avisa que ¡Soichiro Yagami ha sufrido un ataque al corazón!

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Grandes Mitos

programme.title: ¡ALTO! Frontera

programme.title: ¡ALTO! Frontera

programme.title: ¡ALTO! Frontera

programme.title: ¡ALTO! Frontera

programme.title: ¡ALTO! Frontera

programme.title: ¡ALTO! Frontera

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere ver un programa en la televisión, pero los vecinos no mantendrán el ruido bajo. No hay lugar en su casa para escapar de tan odioso sonido. Bean comienza a tener pensamientos de venganza.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Después de no recibir una invitación para la fiesta de cumpleaños de Marc, Kenan se siente rechazado. Mientras tanto, todo el mundo incluyendo Kel, piensa que Kenan tiene que hacerse una operación de orejas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan escribe un poema de amor inspirado en Sharla. Pero Kel le hace creer a su compañera, Alison, que su novio Phillip escribió el poema. Cuando Alison rompe con su novio por culpa de Kel, los chicos intentan remediar la situación.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Ansioso por saber qué le compraron sus padres como regalo de cumpleaños, Kenan se mete en su habitación y encuentra un paquete, pero Kel lo rompe por accidente. Ahora los chicos tienen que correr para reemplazar el regalo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel destruye las fotos para el anuario de la escuela, y ahora él y Kenan deben ayudar a su compañero Marc Cram a reemplazar las fotos.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel salen a pasear y deciden entrar en una tienda de ropa, pero una serie de hechos desafortunados hacen que Kenan acabe perdiendo su camisa y su pantalón. Como resultado, Kenan queda atrapado en la tienda en ropa interior.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan quiere invitar a Sharla al Baile del Amor, pero tiene miedo de preguntarle, así que le dice a todos que irá al baile con Tamia, una cantante famosa. Pero primero debe conocer a la chica y convencerla de ir al baile con él.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Chris se va de vacaciones y deja a Kenan y Kel a cargo de su casa por unos días. Parece que todo está bajo control, sin embargo las cosas empiezan a ir terriblemente mal ¡cuando se olvidan de cuidar la casa!

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan se convierte en un héroe cuando captura a un peligroso criminal en la tienda de comestibles Rigby's. Cuando el criminal escapa de la prisión, decide ir a la casa de Kenan para vengarse.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan conoce a una chica rica y alquila una limusina llevarla al restaurante más caro de la ciudad. El problema es que no contaba con que Kel se metiera en el medio para arruinar todo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Cuando el campeón de duelos del país, un magnate despiadado llamado Seto Kaiba, secuestra al abuelo de Yugi para obtener su carta rara, el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules; ¡Yugi tiene que luchar contra Kaiba en el duelo de monstruos máximo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi está obligado a retar en un partido de duelo de monstruos contrar el creador de el juego, Maximillion Pegasus, en el misterioso Reino de las Sombras, a donde todos los monstruos y magia son reales.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi sacrificia sus propia estrellas para que Joey viaje en el bote yendo al Reino de los Duelos, para que pueda batirse en duelo para guardar la visión de su hermana, Serenity.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus anuncia que hay muchos secretos raros que aseguran que su torneo máximo va ser como nada que se ha visto antes. ¡Yugi tendrá que resolver y dominar las reglas del concurso para sobrevivir!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despues que Yugi vence los primeros monstruos de duelos de Weevil, el engañoso revela un truco final, ¡el Gran Moth hambrienta, que le sube el poder con cada turno! ¿Podrar Yugi vencer esta monstruosidad lada antes que lo destruya a él?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey valientamente acepta un duelo contra una duelista veterana, Mai. Pero cuando Mai demonstra una abilidad síquica espantosa, ¡Joey tendrá que resolver la estrategia secreta de Mai antes que él le caiga victima!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un duelista pescador, Mako, reta a Yugi a un duelo al lado del mar. Yugi lleva una gran desventaja porque no puede ver los monstruos marinos de Mako abajo del mar.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La junta directiva de KaibaCorp tiene intención de quitarle el poder de la compañía a Kaiba y entregarsela a Pegasus si Yugi es eliminado del torneo. Mokuba, el hermano menor de Kaiba, ¡reta a Yugi a un duelo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta en duelo contra un doble magio de Seto Kaiba. Pero con sus mejores cartas en el fondo del mar, ¡Yugi tendrá que descubrir una nueva estrategía para sobrevivir a los ataques de Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules del Kaiba Fantasma!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Después que Yugi logra vencer el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, dos copias más del monstruo salen a battalar! El verdadero Kaiba corre a ayudar a Yugi ganar el duelo, ¿pero llegará a tiempo?

programme.title: Black Kamen Rider

programme.desc: Spencer y la Señora Benson deben salvar a los chicos antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Tras hallarlos en la carretera, logran llegar antes de que empiece la competencia, pero como no tienen identificaciones y les prohíben la entrada.

programme.title: iCarly: Yo lo ví primero
programme.desc: Cuando Sam y Carly muestran interés por el mismo chico amigo de Freddie, ellas prometen que no interferirá entre su amistad. Resulta ser más complicado de lo que imaginaban, y pronto su amistad se pone a prueba.

programme.title: iCarly: La intervención
programme.desc: Carly debe hacer algo ya que Spencer se ha vuelto adicto a un video juego. Mientras tanto Sam engaña a Freddie haciéndole creer que por no seguir una cadena de correos electrónicos, le traerá una eterna mala suerte.

programme.title: iCarly: La deuda
programme.desc: Sam se encuentra ofendida por Freddie ya que la acusa de no devolver el dinero que él y Carly le han prestado. Sam hace todo lo posible para devolverles el dinero, incluso consigue un trabajo.

programme.title: iCarly: Lastimamos a Lewbert
programme.desc: El show molestando a Lewbert sale terriblemente mal y el odioso portero termina herido. Los chicos cuidan a Lewbert hasta que la mamá de Freddie se hace cargo del cuidado. Cuando un romance comienza a florecer entre ellos, deben detenerlo.

programme.title: iCarly: Locos por las tartas
programme.desc: Cuando Carly, Sam y Spencer llevan a Freddie a conocer su lugar de tartas favorito, se enteran que el dueño se encuentra muy enfermo y finalmente fallece. Spencer, Sam y Carly se dan cuenta que las recetas se han perdido para siempre.

programme.title: iCarly: La Navidad
programme.desc: Con la intención de cambiar la tradición navideña Spencer consigue un árbol poco convencional, que accidentalmente prende fuego todos los regalos que Carly ha dejado en él. Enojadísima, ella pide el deseo de tener un hermano más normal.

programme.title: iCarly: El primer beso
programme.desc: Sam oye por casualidad a Freddie confesándole a Carly que nunca ha besado a una chica, y decide revelar su secreto en el show. Gibby y Carly entrenan a Spencer para una prueba con el equipo de fútbol profesional local.

programme.title: iCarly: Regalo un auto
programme.desc: Los chicos lanzan un concurso en iCarly, el premio es un auto nuevo cortesía del dueño del concesionario local. Luego que Nevel resulte ganador, los chicos descubren que le dueño del concesionario no sabía nada sobre el concurso.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Ryuk el Shinigami, que dejó caer el Death Note en el mundo humano advierte a Light que alguien le sigue la pista. Light está preocupado por no poder descubrir la identidad de su perseguidor, pero Ryuk le propone un trato sorprendente...

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conocido mundialmente como Kira, prueba el alcance de los poderes del Death Note matando a 6 convictos de diferentes maneras, así confirma que puede controlar las acciones de sus víctimas ¡antes de que mueran!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Soichiro Yagami demanda una reunión en persona con L cuando se entera que él secretamente ha traído agentes del FBI a Japón, mientras tanto, Light ha encontrado una manera de sacar a los agentes del FBI ¡permanentemente del caso!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light se reúne con una mujer en el departamento de policía ya que tiene un mensaje importante para el cuerpo especial Kira, como hijo del investigador en jefe, Light escucha su historia y descubre que ella posee información que podría llevar a su arresto!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light usa el Death Note para tratar de deshacerse de la mujer que podría capturarlo, y se sorprende cuando no funciona. Ella le ha dado un nombre falso. Light solo tiene minutos para averiguar su nombre antes de contar su historia a la policía.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: L insiste en plantar micrófonos y cámaras en los hogares de los miembros del cuerpo especial incluyendo la casa de Yagami, pero como siempre, Light está un paso adelante, sabe que está siendo observado!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Los asesinatos continúan y L empieza a sospechar del comportamiento perfecto de Light así que decide investigarlo por su cuenta, para poder alcanzar su meta, L se inscribe a la misma universidad que Light.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Las sospechas de L se profundizan, Light lo persuade de invitarlo a la investigación, pero en ese momento una llamada de teléfono les avisa que ¡Soichiro Yagami ha sufrido un ataque al corazón!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM
programme.desc: Nankatsu defiende a toda costa la portería a la espera de su capitán Tsubasa, quien se empecina en volver a la cancha. Hyuga aprovecha la situación.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM
programme.desc: Nankatsu y Toho anotan tres goles cada uno. Una falta de Takasugi le regala un tiro libre a Hyuga, quien se dispone a usar su poderoso tiro de tigre.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM
programme.desc: La final va a tiempo extra. Ni Tsubasa ni Hyuga desean compartir el título, y están dispuestos a arriesgar su físico por el Torneo Nacional.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa LATAM

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decide batirse en duelo contra Rex Raptor, sin ninguna ayuda de sus amigos. Los dinosaurios de Rex Raptor acaban con los monstruos mejores de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un compañero de escuela de Yugi, Bakura, poseído por la energía de su Sortija Milenio, ¡atrapa a Yugi y sus amigos en el Reino de las Sombras donde se convierten en las propias cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un duelista llamado Panik, que está trabajando por Pegasus como eliminador de otros duelistas, le hace trampa a Mai y le quita todos sus estrellas. Yugi prometa ganarlas para trás y reta a Panik a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A pesar de una desventaja grandisima, Yugi proclama valientamente que va a vencer a Panik en solamente tres turnos. ¿Está Yugi blofeando, o tendrá él una estrategia secreta?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: iCarly: Haciendo femenina a Sam

programme.title: iCarly: El reencuentro con Missy
programme.desc: Missy, una vieja amiga de Carly, se muda a la ciudad de Seattle. Sam cree que es agradable en un principio. Pero rápidamente ella comienza a sospechar que Missy en verdad quiere reemplazarla como mejor amiga de Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Debo tener el casillero 239

programme.title: iCarly: Yo peleo con Shelby Marx
programme.desc: Carly bromea en su sitio web con que es capaz de darle una paliza a Shelby Marx, una ruda boxeadora femenina. Shelby lo toma a mal y ahora Carly debe pelear con ella.

programme.title: iCarly: Los premios iCarly

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Con un segundo Kira suelto, L le pide a Light que se una al grupo de trabajo y se haga pasar por el verdadero Kira para atrapar al imitador.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light viaja a Aoyama para descubrir la identidad de el segundo Kira antes de que L sospeche más, pero Misa Amane, la nueva Kira, usa su inusual don para encontrar a Light antes de que él la encuentre.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light y Misa muestran sus Death Notes, entonces Light le pide a Misa que use a su Shinigami Rem para que se deshaga de L, pero Misa le pide algo a cambio, ¡que se enamore de ella!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Hay evidencia que señala a Misa Amane como el segundo Kira, en un esfuerzo para salvarla, Rem obliga a Misa a renunciar como propietaria del Death Note.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Misa está en confinamiento a pesar de que sus recuerdos del Death Note han sido borrados. Cuando Light es encerrado también, los asesinatos se detienen y las sospechas hacia Light se vuelven más fuertes. De repente los asesinatos comienzan de nuevo.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Después de 50 días de reclusión, los asesinatos continúan, Misa y Light son liberados, pero L tiene un plan para garantizar que no se cometan más homicidios, por lo que el padre de Light, Soichiro, lleva a la pareja en un viaje que podría ser el último.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que L aún sospecha, Light y Misa (sus recuerdos de haber sido Kira han sido borrados) regresan al cuartel donde Light se da cuenta de una extraña conección entre los recientes asesinatos de Kira y el Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Matsuda el elemento del cuerpo especial encargado de vigilar a Misa, está ansioso por sobresalir, mientras está en una misión con Misa, decide husmear por su cuenta en el cuartel del Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: El equipo aterriza en Francia y se prepara para los partidos. El entrenador ordena un día de descanso, pero Tsubasa no puede relajarse. Mientras pasea por París, ve a alguien que le resulta conocido y tiene habilidades asombrosas.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Es la ceremonia de apertura del Torneo Internacional Juvenil, y Misaki está pensando en su tiempo en Japón y lo lejos que ha llegado. Pero no todos los recuerdos son felices. La carrera de su padre como artista no ha sido fácil para ninguno de los dos.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Japón enfrenta a Italia en el partido inaugural del torneo y las tensiones aumentan. El equipo japonés está encendido por los comentarios negativos de Italia. Aún así, Tsubasa está a la altura de las circunstancias y determinado.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: El portero de Italia, Gino Hernández, hace paradas increíbles. Su récord perfecto le ha dado la reputación de ser el mejor portero de Europa. Su habilidad pone a Japón a la ofensiva, pero Misaki está observando. El entrenador hace un cambio sorprendente.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Gracias a Tsubasa y Misaki, Japón empata con Italia, dejando a los europeos reforzando sus defensas con la esperanza de nivelarse. Mientras tanto, cuando sólo falta un minuto para el final, la multitud clama por el equipo de Japón. Tsubasa se arriesga...

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Francia, el país anfitrión, tiene su primer partido contra Inglaterra. Elle Sid Pierre, el capitán francés, sorprende con su elegante juego. Mientras tanto, aun cuando Tsubasa y sus amigos están impresionados, el equipo de Francia siente la presión.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc
programme.desc: Roberto Hongo, habla con Katagiri en las afueras de París y no quiere que Tsubasa se entere que está a sólo kilómetros de distancia. Como ex entrenador de Tsubasa, Roberto todavía se siente culpable de haber roto la promesa que le hizo.
